title: French fries from a shared fryer
notes: The same oil is used for calamari, so equipment sharing matters.
dishes: Plain french fries fried in the same oil and fryer that the restaurant also uses for fried calamari.
criteria: Identify the shared cookware or production line.
Do not treat the fries as KOSHER just because potatoes are plant-based.
Mention cross-contact with non-kosher seafood or the need to know how the fryer is used.
